plugin_desc: MRV OptiDriver optical transmission SNMP child template for devices under MRV PEN 629 (NBS-CMMC). Interface traffic is supplied by the shared Transmission SNMP IF-MIB floor. Private health comes from nbsCmmcChassisTable: chassis temperature in degrees Celsius (nbsCmmcChassisTemperature, Integer32 with no scaling; unsupported sentinel -2147483648 is skipped), power supply 1-4 status, fan 1-8 status and chassis power sufficiency. CPU and memory are not published as stable shared objects, so they are not collected. Supported brands/models — MRV OptiDriver and NBS optical transmission chassis.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: temperature_celsius
metrics.description: MRV OptiDriver chassis temperature in degrees Celsius (NBS-CMMC nbsCmmcChassisTemperature under PEN 629, indexed by chassisIdx). The SNMP object is Integer32 with no scaling. Unsupported instances report -2147483648 and those samples are skipped. High values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Status of chassis power supplies 1-4 from NBS-CMMC nbsCmmcChassisPS1Status..PS4Status (1.3.6.1.4.1.629.200.6.1.1.7-.10). good / acGood / dcGood are normal (1); bad / acBad / dcBad are abnormal (2); notInstalled and notSupported are not reported.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Status of chassis fans 1-8 from NBS-CMMC nbsCmmcChassisFan1Status..Fan4Status (1.3.6.1.4.1.629.200.6.1.1.11-.14) and Fan5Status..Fan8Status (.36-.39). good is normal (1) and bad is abnormal (2); notInstalled and notSupported are not reported.

metrics.name: device_power_sufficiency_state
metrics.description: Whether total chassis power is sufficient, from NBS-CMMC nbsCmmcChassisPowerStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.629.200.6.1.1.51). sufficient is normal (1); insufficient is abnormal (2) and means the chassis will not work correctly; notSupported is not reported.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
